components.name: Lithium-Ion Battery Cells
components.reasoning: These are the fundamental electrochemical cells which store charge within the battery pack. They are procured separately from suppliers like LG Chem, Panasonic, or CATL.

components.name: Cell Modules/Stacks
components.reasoning: Battery cells are typically grouped into manageable stacks for cooling and management purposes, forming distinct cell modules that serve as intermediate components before being assembled into the full battery pack.

components.name: Battery Management System (BMS)
components.reasoning: The BMS monitors, manages, and protects the battery cells in real-time by controlling charging parameters, balancing voltage levels, and ensuring thermal management to prevent overheating and damage.

components.name: Liquid Cooling/Heating Systems
components.reasoning: Essential for maintaining optimal operating temperatures of the batteries, these systems consist of heat sinks, pipes, coolant fluid, and associated hardware that are integrated as a separate subassembly.

components.name: Thermal Barrier Insulation (Foam or Membrane)
components.reasoning: Provides thermal insulation between cell modules to reduce heat transfer, enhance battery efficiency, and protect the mechanical integrity of the cells during operation and extreme conditions.

components.name: Enclosure/Mounting Structure
components.reasoning: This includes the aluminum or steel frame that holds the battery pack in place, provides structural support, and ensures safe installation through connectors and securing devices.

components.name: Fuses/Relays
components.reasoning: Critical safety components used to protect against electrical issues such as short circuits and overcurrents, often procured separately from BMS or assembly kits provided by battery suppliers.

components.name: Battery Disconnect Switches/Safety Clips
components.reasoning: Required for emergency disconnection of the power supply under fault conditions without damaging the components, acting independently to ensure safe maintenance and service of the vehicle's electrical systems.

components.name: Insulating Plastics/Bumpers
components.reasoning: These materials serve to insulate sensitive internal elements from external forces while adding structural integrity and protection against minor impacts, commonly used as pre-assembled subassemblies in battery packaging.

components.name: Connection Terminals/Wiring/Harnesses
components.reasoning: Essential for electrical connectivity between various components within the pack and to the vehicle's main power system, often supplied pre-terminated or semi-finished from specialized manufacturers.
